purpose: Research lessons and failure modes, not discovery whitelist or model training
point_in_time_backtest: insufficient historical social/market/security snapshots; no profit or pre-pump detection claim

cases.name: GTA
cases.lesson: Game launch/trailer is a real narrative trigger; token name does not establish Rockstar affiliation. Prior FiveM/Rockstar market/security audit is preserved in REAL_TOKEN_AUDIT_20261116.md.

cases.name: MIHAO
cases.lesson: Cat memes and profile-picture ecosystem are observable project claims; visually similar clones and conflicting market data require exact mint binding. No inferred organic growth or historical return.

cases.name: Anthropig
cases.lesson: Multiple tokens use this name. Spelling parody of Anthropic remains a hypothesis; no verified official affiliation. Do not substitute Anthropic Inu. Primary project attribution and historical evidence incomplete.

cases.name: PNUT
cases.lesson: Animal news and community takeover can combine. Kraken disclosure describes Peanut story and community management; CTO is not proof of liquidity or insider safety.

cases.name: GOAT
cases.lesson: Kraken risk disclosure says Truth Terminal promoted GOAT but did not create it. AI endorsement and token creation must not be conflated.

cases.name: WIF
cases.lesson: A dog image, esports community and profile picture can spread a meme. This scanner does not presently recognize image semantics or inspect historical profile changes.

cases.name: CHILLGUY
cases.lesson: A public asset reference page is not proof of listing, original-art rights or organic spread. Historical causal and image evidence not reconstructed.

cases.name: Prior real-token rejections
cases.lesson: Market filters, missing insider coverage and unsafe/unsupported program evidence can reject a fashionable narrative. Rejection is not proof a token is a rug pull.

cases.name: Undead Tombstone
cases.lesson: DOJ reports a guilty verdict and abandoned NFT mint after promotional claims. Partnerships, promotion and past gains are not safety evidence. NFT case is a qualitative failure lesson, not a fungible-token backtest.
